name: SkySEOManager | Bulk AI SEO Automation & Optimization
author: Sky Plugins

sections.description:
SkySEOManager is a comprehensive SEO management tool designed to make the process of optimizing your website’s SEO more efficient. It uses advanced Vector Semantic Search to power its internal linking engine, allowing you to find perfect contextual link opportunities across thousands of posts in seconds. You can bulk edit meta titles, descriptions, and featured images for all your posts and pages from a single interface. You can filter content by SEO issues, select only the rows you want to optimize, preserve existing SEO data with a missing-data-only mode, and run scheduled background optimization from the Automation tab. With the Media Optimizer, you can also use AI to automatically generate optimized titles and alt text for your images.

Key Features

  • Full Gutenberg (Block Editor) Support: Experience a native-feeling SEO sidebar in the WordPress block editor. Manage keywords, meta titles, and descriptions without leaving your workspace.
  • Intelligent SEO Scoring: Get real-time feedback on your content with a professional scoring system (0-100). Includes checks for title length, meta description, keyword density, internal/external links, and image alt text.
  • Comprehensive Webmaster Verification: Connect your site to Google Search Console, Bing, Baidu, Yandex, Pinterest, and Norton Safe Web in seconds.

  • Custom Meta Tag Support: Need a specific verification tag for a niche tool? Add any custom verification tags directly from the Webmaster Tools tab.

  • Semantic AI Internal Linking: Uses vector embeddings to scan your entire site and find topically relevant internal link opportunities.

  • Semantic Index Management: Easily build, delete, and manage your site’s semantic index for lightning-fast AI analysis.
  • Bulk Editing Interface: Edit SEO metadata for multiple posts/pages simultaneously
  • Selected-Only AI Optimization: Choose the exact posts you want to optimize instead of running AI on every visible row
  • Missing Data Only Mode: Generate only missing titles and descriptions without replacing existing SEO metadata
  • Automation Tab: Schedule background optimization with WP-Cron and review logs for each run
  • XML Sitemap Tab: Generate sitemap.xml plus post-type sitemaps, with automatic TranslatePress language variants when TranslatePress is active
  • AI Internal Linking Tab: Build contextual internal links in resumable batches, review recent link activity, and visualize the discovered link graph in a zoomable mindmap
  • Internal Link Review Trail: Review which keyword anchors were linked to which destination URLs directly from the Recent Activity panel
  • Editor Internal Linking Review: Analyze a single post or page inside the SEO box, review AI suggestions, and apply individual internal links in one click. Now includes a delete (undo) feature for applied links.
  • Media Optimizer: A new tab to manage and optimize your media library. Use AI to generate titles and alt text for your images.
  • AI-Powered Content Optimization: Use Gemini AI to generate SEO-optimized titles and descriptions for your content.
  • SEO Plugin Integration: Works with popular SEO plugins including Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, The SEO Framework, and more
  • Import Data: Import SEO data from other plugins and delete plugin data when needed
  • Yoast-Style SEO Box: Edit SEO data directly from the post edit screen with live preview, AI generation, robots controls, and internal-link review
  • Indexing & SEO Box Tab: Choose which post types and taxonomies show the SEO box, and set default noindex or nofollow rules for selected post types
  • SEO Filtering: Filter posts by SEO status (missing title, too long description, etc.)
  • Social Media Integration: Configure social media metadata for Twitter and Facebook
  • Schema.org Support: Automatically generates JSON-LD structured data for articles, blog posts, organizations, persons, and more
  • BreadcrumbList Schema: Enable BreadcrumbList structured data to display breadcrumb navigation in Google search results, with customizable separator, home label, and display options
  • Homepage Schema Types: Choose between Organization, Person, LocalBusiness, or WebSite schema for your homepage
  • WooCommerce Integration: Full support for WooCommerce products with automatic Product schema, BreadcrumbList schema, and product images in sitemaps
  • 404 Monitor: Track broken links, view hit counts and referrers, use AI to suggest redirect targets, and create instant 301/302 redirects to recover lost traffic and SEO value
  • 404 Email Alerts: Get notified by email when 404 errors occur. Configure frequency (immediate, hourly, daily), minimum hit thresholds, and custom SMTP settings
  • Robots.txt Manager: Create and manage your website’s robots.txt file using a visual builder, and use AI to analyze it against SEO best practices
  • Taxonomy SEO & Bulk Editing: Add featured images to categories/tags and smoothly bulk edit taxonomy SEO metadata using AI
  • Debug Mode: Helps troubleshoot plugin detection issues
  • Manual SEO Plugin Override: Manually set which SEO plugin’s metadata to use
  • HTML Sitemap: Add an HTML sitemap to any page using the shortcode: [skyseo_html_sitemap]. This shortcode outputs standard HTML with no CSS styling as requested.
  • AI 404 Redirect Suggest Use AI to fix all 404 issue get quick recommendations and fix all your 404

🚀 Upgrade to SkySEOManager Pro

Unlock advanced features with SkySEOManager Pro!

Pro Features Include:
* Bulk Media Optimization – AI-powered optimization for your entire media library
* AI-Powered Media Title & Alt Text Generation – Automatically generate SEO-friendly image metadata
* Advanced Media Filtering – Filter images by missing titles, alt text, or other criteria
* License Management – Easy license activation, deactivation, and validation
* Priority Support – Dedicated support for Pro users
* Regular Updates – Get access to all new Pro features and improvements

👉 Get SkySEOManager Pro

Available in Single Site and Multi-Site licenses

Supported SEO Plugins

  • Yoast SEO
  • Rank Math SEO
  • All In One SEO
  • SEOPress
  • The SEO Framework
  • SmartCrawl
  • Squirrly SEO

Video Tutorial

External services

This plugin uses the Google Gemini API (Generative Language API) to generate SEO-optimized titles, meta descriptions, image alt texts, internal linking suggestions, and 404 redirect suggestions.

When you use the AI features, the content of your posts, pages, 404 URLs, candidate destination details, or the specific text prompts you provide are sent securely to Google’s API to generate the relevant SEO recommendations. No content is sent automatically without user interaction or scheduled tasks configured explicitly by you.

This service is provided by Google:
* Google API Terms of Service
* Google Privacy Policy

Usage

Bulk Editing SEO Data

  1. Navigate to the ‘SkySEOManager’ page in your WordPress admin menu
  2. Select the post type you want to edit from the dropdown
  3. Use filters to find posts with specific SEO issues (optional)
  4. Edit titles, descriptions, and featured images directly in the table
  5. Select one or more rows and click ‘AI Optimize Selected’ to run AI only on the checked posts
  6. Enable ‘Only add missing data’ if you want to keep any existing title or description unchanged
  7. Changes are saved automatically as you work

Automation Tab

  1. Navigate to ‘SkySEOManager’ > ‘Automation’
  2. Enable the automatic optimizer if you want WordPress to run AI optimization in the background
  3. Choose the frequency, post types, optimization mode, and batch size
  4. Save the automation settings
  5. Review the optimization logs to see which posts were updated, skipped, or failed during each scheduled run

Sitemap Tab

  1. Navigate to ‘SkySEOManager’ > ‘Sitemap’
  2. Enable sitemap generation and select the public post types you want included
  3. Save settings and open /sitemap.xml
  4. If your site uses TranslatePress, SkySEOManager automatically creates language-specific sitemap variants for the selected post types

Internal Linking Tab

  1. Navigate to ‘SkySEOManager’ > ‘Internal Linking’
  2. Build your Semantic Index by clicking “Build Semantic Index”. This uses vector embeddings to map your site’s topics.
  3. Choose the post types to process, max links per post, candidate pool size, and batch size.
  4. Start a fresh run or resume a paused run when your AI quota becomes available again.
  5. Watch the progress bar, status badge, and zoomable internal-link mindmap while the queue runs.
  6. Review Recent Activity to see which keyword anchors were linked to which destination URLs. Now includes an “X” button to revert any applied link.

Indexing & SEO Box Tab

  1. Navigate to ‘SkySEOManager’ > ‘Indexing & SEO Box’
  2. Choose the post types that should default to noindex or nofollow
  3. Choose exactly which post types should show the SkySEOManager SEO box
  4. Choose which public taxonomies should show SEO fields
  5. Save settings to apply the rules and editor placement

404 Monitor Tab

  1. Navigate to ‘SkySEOManager’ > ‘404 Monitor’
  2. View all recorded 404 URLs with hit counts, first/last seen dates, and referrer information
  3. Use the filter tabs to switch between All, Unresolved, or Redirected entries
  4. Use the search bar to quickly find specific 404 URLs or paths
  5. Click ‘Redirect’ on any unresolved 404 URL to add an instant 301 or 302 or custom URL redirect
  6. Search for existing posts and pages when choosing a redirect target
  7. Remove redirects or delete individual entries at any time
  8. Use ‘Clear All Logs’ to purge the entire 404 log (entries older than 90 days without a redirect are automatically cleaned up)

404 Settings Tab (Email Alerts)

  1. Navigate to ‘SkySEOManager’ > ‘404 Settings’
  2. Enable email alerts using the toggle switch
  3. Configure recipient email address for notifications
  4. Choose email frequency: Immediate, Hourly, or Daily digest
  5. Set minimum hits threshold before triggering email notifications
  6. Configure SMTP settings if your server requires custom email settings
  7. Use ‘Send Test Email’ to verify your email configuration
  8. AI suggestions for 404 pages

Robots.txt Tab

  1. Navigate to ‘SkySEOManager’ > ‘Robots.txt’
  2. Use the visual rule builder to easily allow, disallow, or configure sitemaps
  3. Switch to the raw code editor to make direct changes (automatically synced with visual rules!)
  4. Click ‘AI Analyze’ to have Gemini review your robots.txt against modern SEO best practices
  5. Save your rules to immediately apply them to your website

Webmaster Tools Verification

  1. Navigate to ‘SkySEOManager’ > ‘Webmaster Tools’
  2. Google & Bing: Paste your site verification IDs to instantly verify your ownership.
  3. Regional Search Engines: Full support for Yandex and Baidu verification tags.
  4. Social & Security: Verify your domain for Pinterest and Norton Safe Web.
  5. Custom Tags: Use the ‘Custom Webmaster Tags’ field to add any specialized meta tags (one per line) for other third-party services.
  6. All tags are safely output in the <head> of your website with proper escaping.

Media Optimizer

  1. Navigate to the ‘SkySEOManager’ > ‘Media Optimizer’ page in your WordPress admin menu
  2. View your media library and their current title and alt text.
  3. Use the “AI Optimize” button to generate new title and alt text for an image.

Importing Data from Other SEO Plugins

  1. Go to ‘SkySEOManager’ > ‘Settings’
  2. Scroll down to the ‘Import/Export SEO Data’ section
  3. Select the SEO plugin you want to import data from
  4. Click ‘Start Import’ and wait for the process to complete
  5. The progress bar will show the import status

Deleting SEO Data

  1. Go to ‘SkySEOManager’ > ‘Settings’
  2. To delete SkySEOManager data: Use the ‘Delete SkySEOManager Data’ button
  3. To delete other SEO plugin data: Select the plugin from the dropdown in the ‘Delete Data From Other SEO Plugins’ section and click ‘Delete Plugin Data’

Changing SEO Plugin Integration

  1. Go to ‘SkySEOManager’ > ‘Settings’
  2. Scroll down to ‘Manual SEO Plugin Override’
  3. Select your desired SEO plugin from the dropdown
  4. Click ‘Set SEO Plugin Manually’
  5. To revert to automatic detection, use the ‘Force Re-detection of SEO Plugins’ button

Enabling Debug Mode

  1. Go to ‘SkySEOManager’ > ‘Settings’
  2. Check the ‘Enable debug mode’ option
  3. Save changes
  4. Debug information will now be displayed in the settings page
  5. CSS and JS files will use cache busting to ensure fresh versions on each load

SEO Meta Box & Gutenberg Sidebar

  1. Edit any post or page
  2. Look for the redesigned SkySEOManager SEO box in the editor (Classic) or the SkySEOManager Sidebar (Gutenberg).
  3. Keyword Management: Add your focus keywords to trigger real-time SEO analysis.
  4. Dynamic SEO Score: Watch your score update as you improve your title, description, and content density.
  5. Use the Snippet Editor tab to manage SEO title and description with live SERP preview
  6. Use the Internal Linking tab to analyze the saved page content, review suggested anchors, and apply links one by one. If no index exists, a shortcut button will guide you to generate it.
  7. Use the Advanced tab for per-item noindex and nofollow controls

Gutenberg SEO Blocks

  1. Open any post or page in the Gutenberg (Block) Editor
  2. Click the + button to add a new block
  3. Scroll down to the “Sky SEO Manager” block category (or search for the blocks directly)
  4. Add the Sky SEO FAQ, Sky SEO How-To, or Sky SEO Review block to your content
  5. Fill out the interactive fields (questions, steps, or review ratings) directly in the editor
  6. When you publish the post, SkySEOManager will automatically generate valid JSON-LD Schema.org markup for your rich snippets!

Configuring Social Media Settings

  1. Go to ‘SkySEOManager’ > ‘Settings’
  2. Enter your Twitter username and Facebook page URL
  3. Add your company name and logo URL for rich snippets
  4. Save changes
sections.installation:
1. Upload the skyseomanager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to the ‘SkySEOManager’ menu item in the WordPress admin panel to start using the plugin
sections.faq:
Will this plugin work with my existing SEO plugin?

Yes! SkySEOManager is designed to detect and work with most popular SEO plugins including Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, and others. It will read and write to the same meta fields used by your existing SEO plugin.

Will importing data from another SEO plugin delete the original data?

No, importing data only copies the information from the other plugin to SkySEOManager’s format. The original data remains untouched unless you specifically use the delete functionality.

What happens if no SEO plugin is detected?

If no supported SEO plugin is detected, SkySEOManager will use its own meta fields to store SEO data and will output the necessary meta tags in your website’s header.

How do I know if my titles and descriptions are optimized?

The plugin includes visual indicators that show when your titles and descriptions are within the recommended length ranges. Green indicates optimal length, yellow indicates too short, and red indicates too long.

Can I use this plugin on multisite?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with WordPress multisite installations.

How does the 404 Monitor work?

The 404 Monitor automatically logs every 404 (Page Not Found) error that visitors encounter on your site. It records the broken URL, hit count, referrer, and timestamps. You can then create instant 301 (permanent) or 302 (temporary) redirects to fix broken links and recover lost SEO value. Entries older than 90 days without an active redirect are automatically cleaned up to keep your database tidy.

How do 404 Email Alerts work?

Navigate to ‘SkySEOManager’ > ‘404 Settings’ to configure email notifications. You can enable/disable alerts, set recipient email, choose frequency (immediate/hourly/daily), and set minimum hit thresholds. Custom SMTP settings are available for servers with restricted mail configuration. Use the test email button to verify your setup.
